verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that connects an AI assistant to its marketing stack. Through it an agent can build audiences, manage and create syncs, design and analyze journeys, and generate ad creatives in plain language, with example prompts. A probe also confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: MCP-specific connection and authentication setup details in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the server.
